name: Scarlet-Lunari Noxheim
original_name: スカーレット＝ルナリ・ノクスヘイム
source:
Scarlet is the current Empress Consort of Noxheim and Irena's stepmother.

To secure the throne for her own daughter, Lilia, she schemes to bring down Irena - a legitimate heir to the throne.

She is a hardline aristocratic supremacist.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara06.html]official website[/url]]
